# heraut commit verify

Validate a commit message against the conventional-commit grammar.

Check one commit message against the Conventional Commits grammar, and against the types and rules
in .heraut.yml when it has any. Prints the parsed type, scope and tickets; exits 1 when the message is
invalid. Merge and fixup commits are accepted as they are. Made for a commit-msg hook.

## Usage

```text
heraut commit verify [message] [flags]
```

## Examples

```bash
heraut commit verify "fix(parser): handle empty input"
heraut commit verify --file .git/COMMIT_EDITMSG
```

## Flags

| Flag | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--file <string>` |  | read the commit message from a file (use - for stdin) |
| `--json` |  | print the result as a JSON envelope |

## Global flags

| Flag | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--config <string>` |  | path to .heraut.yml (default: auto-discover) |
| `--verbose` |  | echo each command and emit diagnostic logs |
